Multi-step tasks became available in India, Japan and the UK in Google's November 2026 Pixel Drop.
Gemini can carry out multi-step requests such as ordering groceries, booking a ride, ordering takeout or making a restaurant reservation.
Task automation supports Pixel 10, Motorola Signature 27 and select Samsung Galaxy models.
Device Assistance on select Android 17+ devices handles tasks such as clearing storage and checking location permissions.
Some features require users to meet age, language and subscription requirements.
